prompt: Which steps belong in a hybrid retrieval pipeline that combines BM25 and embeddings, as described by Anthropic?

options.text: Split the knowledge base into chunks of usually no more than a few hundred tokens.
Use BM25 to find top chunks by exact lexical match.
Use embeddings to find top chunks by semantic similarity.
Combine and deduplicate both result lists using rank fusion.
Discard the embedding results whenever BM25 returns anything.
Send every chunk of the corpus to the model and let it choose.

explanation: The pipeline runs both retrievers over the same chunks, merges and deduplicates with rank fusion, then passes the top-K chunks to the generator. Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges ranked lists by position, so documents ranked highly in several lists rise.

sources.title: Relevance scoring in hybrid search using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (Microsoft Learn)
